english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act of getting ready and the resulting state of readiness, as in 考試前嘅準備.
Use this for preparation made beforehand, rather than for the supplies or money themselves.

examples.english: You need to make good preparation before the exam.
examples.jyutping: haau2 si3 cin4 jiu3 zou6 hou2 zeon2 bei6

examples.english: We made provision for the event well in advance, so we would not be flustered on the day.
examples.traditional: 我哋一早就為個活動做好準備，臨場唔會手忙腳亂。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 zou2 zau6 wai6 go3 wut6 dung6 zou6 hou2 zeon2 bei6 lam4 coeng4 m4 wui5 sau2 mong4 goek3 lyun6
